CHAPTER.VERS:
Blessed transgression forgiven, sin covered.
A Psalm…: or, A Psalm of David giving instruction
Blessed the man to whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit no guile.
When I kept silence, my bones became old through my roaring all the day long.
For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
I acknowledged my sin to thee, and my iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

For this shall every one that is godly pray to thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come near to him.
when…: Heb. of finding
Thou my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with my eye.
guide…: Heb. counsel thee, mine eye shall be upon thee
Be ye not as the horse, as the mule, have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near to thee.
Many sorrows to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall surround him.
Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all upright in heart.
